name: modern-racing-manager
description: Single-player motorsport team management game, 2010-2026. Offline-first PWA. Personal use.

scripts.e2e: vite build && vite build --outDir dist-next && node e2e/run.cjs
scripts.lab: rolldown scripts/sim-lab.ts --file node_modules/.cache/lab/sim-lab.mjs --platform node --log-level warn && node node_modules/.cache/lab/sim-lab.mjs
scripts.lab:push: rolldown scripts/push-lab.ts --file node_modules/.cache/lab/push-lab.mjs --platform node --log-level warn && node node_modules/.cache/lab/push-lab.mjs
scripts.lab:push-solo: rolldown scripts/push-solo.ts --file node_modules/.cache/lab/push-solo.mjs --platform node --log-level warn && node node_modules/.cache/lab/push-solo.mjs
scripts.lab:styles: rolldown scripts/style-lab.ts --file node_modules/.cache/lab/style-lab.mjs --platform node --log-level warn && node node_modules/.cache/lab/style-lab.mjs
scripts.lab:tyres: rolldown scripts/tyre-lab.ts --file node_modules/.cache/lab/tyre-lab.mjs --platform node --log-level warn && node node_modules/.cache/lab/tyre-lab.mjs
